## Changes
- **Landers with one gimballed engine land.** A light lander with several engines, of which only one is on a gimbal, could not land with DEORBIT + LAND: RCS swung it through the braking burn, and touchdown guidance lost its plan. AFC now switches RCS off while an engine on a gimbal burns in a landing, so that the gimbal alone points the craft, and switches it on again when the engine is off or the landing ends. The new expert setting **STEER BURN WITH GIMBAL** on LAND (on by default) turns this off. Touchdown guidance now plans with the torque that the gimbal really gives, and lands a craft with no roll torque upright at whatever heading it has. ([#151](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/151))
- **Landing legs come down by themselves.** The new **LEGS** fold on LAND deploys every landing leg once during a landing, at **LEGS DOWN AT** over the ground (1000 m by default). A retract or a deploy by hand stands. **COM ABOVE LEGS** now reads only the landing legs as deployed, not ramps, dishes or bay doors. ([#153](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/153))
- **Touchdown guidance flies its plan to the ground.** In rare cases the last quarter second before touchdown was flown without gimbal steering after a new plan arrived. A plan that ends without ground contact now says "TOUCHDOWN ENDED ITS PLAN WITHOUT CONTACT" instead of "LOST PLAN". ([#151](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/151))

## Known limits
- With **STEER BURN WITH GIMBAL** on, RCS translation and roll control are not available during the landing burn. A craft with no roll torque keeps the roll rate it has at ignition.
- A player who joins a multiplayer game during such a burn sees the craft with RCS on.
- A craft that cannot hover can tip over after touchdown on a slope of 10 degrees or more.
- An automatic entry from orbit on a body with air is refused.

AFC needs StarMap and no other mod.
